question: The firing with firing_ref 'KB-20250314-40001' was a rejected firing. Find which stock lot(s) of raw material were drawn for this firing. Then find every OTHER firing that drew from any of the same stock lot(s). Then find which clients received dispatches containing parts from any of those firings, listing each client with the quantity dispatched to them, and give the total quantity across all those clients.
